headline: House scores two big votes as new California rep takes the oath, with mining protection narrowly passing and court-packing amendment falling short!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate was not in session on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, and stands in recess. The chamber will reconvene Friday for a pro forma session.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House swore in Representative Aisha Wahab of California's 14th District following her special election victory on August 18, bringing the chamber to 433 members. The body voted on mining legislation and a constitutional amendment on the Supreme Court's size, passing the former while rejecting the latter.
